portInfo.description: AP Coruña’s site covers interior vs exterior (Punta Langosteira) docks; cruises use the city-facing interior. Passenger service tariffs appear on the pasaje page. BOE/AP materials extend the Corunna Cruise Terminal concession at Trasatlánticos (exploitation of the maritime station). Tourism board turismocoruna.com is the city visitor primary.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Muelle de Trasatlánticos / Corunna Cruise Terminal — Interior port, A Coruña (Trasatlánticos quay)
gettingThere.distanceToCity: City centre from Trasatlánticos is a short urban walk/taxi. Outer quays may use AP-organised shuttles on peak days.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Tower of Hercules — timed north trip
Know your quay — check if you are on Trasatlánticos or an overflow berth
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: On five-ship mornings, follow AP/Corunna Cruise Terminal shuttle signage — do not walk unknown dock roads.
